about: COP31 closing check-in, decisions (25 November 2026). The conference ended on Sunday 22 November without the presidency's proposed cover decision; separate negotiated decisions were adopted. Sources were found by web search from the build session and could not be read here, so each term is taken from the report's headline or from the wording search results quoted from it; a claim reaches a page only if the source check finds every term on the page. Readings of how good or bad the outcome was are left out: the site describes what was adopted, what was not, and what each step does not yet show. After the first check (25 November): the indicators claim was narrowed to the task force (the guidance date was not found on the pages), and the heat resilience roadmap launch place was not found on UNEP's summary, so that claim stays dropped.

claims.text: COP31 closed on Sunday 22 November 2026 without adopting the presidency's proposed cover decision, the Antalya Pact.
Negotiated decisions on separate agenda items, including adaptation, were adopted even though the cover decision was not.
Parties agreed to set up a task force to refine the adaptation indicators agreed at COP30. The source check did not confirm the date by which its guidance is due, so none is given.
The final text set no figure for tripling adaptation finance: a proposed US$120 billion figure for 2035 was dropped, and countries agreed only to discuss how to triple it.
Decisions at COP31 enable the Adaptation Fund to receive a share of the proceeds of carbon trading under the Paris Agreement's crediting mechanism.
The first draft of the cover decision carried a paragraph on climate change and health; with the cover decision not adopted, no health text was agreed in it.
UNEP reports that work began at COP31 on a heat resilience roadmap, to be launched next year in Ethiopia.
By the end of COP31, 136 national adaptation plans had been submitted.
